text:
maya: heads up — main pipeline turned red ~5m after my tiny doc + test tweak got merged. looks like a flaky test surfaced

ci-bot: [CI] Pipeline failed on branch main (run 98765) — failing job: smoke-gpu-quick. Logs: https://ci.internal/red/98765 :rotating_light:

alex: @maya thanks for flagging. can you paste the failing test name? i'll grab the run if it's infra-related

maya: failing test is `test_inference_batch_padding` in smoke-gpu-quick. error is an assertion on sequence lengths. i did touch test utils but only formatting. here's the tail of the log:
```
E   AssertionError: expected sequence length 64 but got 65
/opt/ci/workspace/tests/smoke/test_inference.py:42
FAILED tests/smoke/test_inference.py::test_inference_batch_padding - AssertionError: expected...
```

sree: hmm could be nondeterministic kvcache behavior under small batch sizes. i've seen 1-off length drift when truncation code hits edge case.

alex: ok i'm pulling the job. running `ci rerun 98765 --job smoke-gpu-quick --with-logs`

ci-bot: [CI] Rerun queued by alex (run 98765) — job smoke-gpu-quick

oncall: if this is a flaky, we can rerun once to confirm and then bisect if it reproduces consistently. maya — do you have the commit hash?

maya: commit 8a7f3c4 — small refactor in tests/utils.py. i can revert quickly if needed.

alex: rerun is started. pinging infra in case the GPU nodes had a noisy neighbor. @oncall any cluster alerts?

oncall: no cluster-wide alerts in last 30m. provisioning looks normal. i'll watch.

ci-bot: [CI] Rerun started — job smoke-gpu-quick (run 98766)

ci-bot: [CI] Rerun completed — job smoke-gpu-quick (run 98766) — status: FAILURE

alex: reproducible on rerun. that's not great. @sree can you try a local repro with `pytest -k test_inference_batch_padding -q --seed=7`? maybe we can flush KV cache to see if that changes result.

sree: running locally now. also trying with `--max-batch-size=8` and `--seed=1..10` to check nondeterminism. will update in ~10m.

maya: if this is caused by my tests change i'm happy to revert immediately. was hoping to avoid churn.

alex: let's not revert yet — we should confirm root cause. if it's our test change then revert + patch. if infra, then escalate.

sree: quick update — i reproduced locally with seed 3. looks like pad/truncation writes one extra token on boundary when using `pack_sequences` helper. suspect off-by-one in new util.

alex: thanks. can you open a quick PR fixing `pack_sequences` and include a targeted unit test? tag me and maya for review. if you need a rollback to unstick main, i'll file a revert.

maya: going to standby — happy to review and test patch. sorry about the noise. :sheepish:

sree: PR opened: https://git.internal/infra/pack-fix (small fix + test). queued CI run on branch.

ci-bot: [CI] New PR build started — PR 1234 (pack-fix)

alex: if PR CI passes can we merge with fast-track? this blocks a downstream deploy.

oncall: recommend at least one review + green CI. if CI flakes, we'll escalate to emergency revert.

sree: all green locally and on PR CI so far. merging in 2m.

ci-bot: [CI] PR 1234 merged into main by sree — triggering main pipeline

ci-bot: [CI] Pipeline started on main (run 98770) — smoke-gpu-quick queued

ci-bot: [CI] Pipeline completed (run 98770) — status: SUCCESS :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks everyone — good to see green. i'll follow up with a small note in the PR about adding a fuzz seed to smoke tests.

alex: nice work. quick lesson: small test helpers can surface tricky nondeterminism.

sree: Agreed. adding deterministic seeding in pack utility + docstring.

maya: closing the loop — will watch for any regressions and add an eval prompt to avoid similar slips. :+1:
